darkbot
Twitch Redemptions OBS

Sounds

Reconnect Twitch once so darkbot can create rewards for your sounds.

Connect your Twitch channel

darkbot listens for channel point redemptions and plays the sound you assign to each reward.

Assign a sound to one of your channel point rewards.

Click a pad to preview it. Viewers trigger it with channel points.

Activity

    Redemptions appear here as they happen.

    Settings

    Where sounds play

    Audio tracks

    Same tracks as in OBS Advanced Audio Properties. Track 1 is usually the stream.

    Created in the current scene when missing. OBS only plays sources in the active scene, so add it to your other scenes as an existing source.

    Twitch

    Enter this code on twitch.tv/activate

    Twitch application (Client ID)

    Create one at dev.twitch.tv/console: client type Public, redirect URL http://localhost. Channel points need an Affiliate or Partner channel.

    OBS connection

    Needed for “Inside OBS”. In OBS open Tools, then WebSocket Server Settings, and enable the server.

    Updates

    While darkbot is running, new versions are only announced, so a stream is never interrupted.
